purpose: #TBD: a Y card's length= is ignored as ngspice ignores it (inp2y.c reads only len=); the line keeps its TXL model's length.

oracle.derivation: ngspice 44.2 .meas values (7 significant digits, so up to 5e-8 relative rounding); ngspice-45 prints the same lines. A lossless line between matched 50 ohm ends is a pure delay of len*sqrt(L C), the closed form in the deck header: the model's 1 m arrives at 5 ns, so v(o) reads 0.5 V at 8 ns, where the card's 2 m would still read ngspice's 0.1 gmin port stamp (-1.25e-12 V). Every sample sits on a flat plateau: rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-9 V. The build that read the card's length= reads o_8 = -1.25e-12.
